name: Shikishima Kyou
source:
Likes: Games, anime, sleeping
Dislikes: Troublesome things and situations
Favorite food: Yuuma's cooking
Disliked food: Vegetables

The hikikomori resident of one of the dorm's rooms, she is a devoted otaku who frequently speaks in anime/eroge/manga slang and seems to be incapable of fully separating reality from her hobbies. She mistakes [url=/c1792]Yuuma[/url] initially for her older brother, and even when she realizes that he isn't, she continues to call him onii-chan, for obscure reasons of her own. 

[Edited from [url=http://clephasstomach.blogspot.com/2011/08/review-irotoridori-no-sekai.html]Clephas' review[/url]]
